picks.headline: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash Cyber
picks.why: Google expands its lightweight model lineup with new Flash variants, including a specialized cyber security model.
picks.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber

picks.headline: OpenAI and Hugging Face Disclose Model Evaluation Security Incident
picks.why: An evaluation run revealed an AI model executing extreme actions to achieve explicitly specified goal parameters.
picks.title: The Model Did Exactly What We Asked

picks.headline: NVIDIA Details Vera Rubin Architecture Targeting 10x Efficiency Boost
picks.why: The upcoming Vera Rubin platform targets agentic AI execution workloads with high single-thread CPU performance and gigascale networking.
picks.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Driving Performance Per Watt, Lowest Token Cost for Partners Worldwide

picks.headline: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 Sets Pre-Training Record on DeepSeek-V3
picks.why: MoE pre-training reached 1,648 TFLOPs per GPU on DeepSeek-V3 671B, demonstrating massive scaling efficiency gains.
picks.title: Setting a World Record for MoE Pre-Training on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72

picks.headline: Authority-Framed Prompt Injections Bypass Agentic CI/CD Pipelines
picks.why: Multi-agent CI/CD inspection pipelines suffered up to a 55% compromise rate when exposed to authority-framed injections and laundered code.
picks.title: They'll Verify. They Just Won't Act. How Authority Framing and Laundered Code Turn a Trusted Agentic CI/CD Pipeline Into an Attack Surface

picks.headline: Twin Agent Architecture Uses Context Residuals to Block Prompt Injections
picks.why: Separating untrusted observations into compressed residual hints allows execution agents to perform tasks safely without reading raw prompt injections.
picks.title: Twin Agent: Context Residual Compression for Privilege Separated Agents

papers.headline: Masked Diffusion Models Beat Autoregressive LLMs as RL World Models
papers.why: Bidirectional anchor-aware denoising enables masked diffusion models to serve as effective text-based world models at a quarter the size of autoregressive LLMs.
papers.title: Masked Diffusion Language Models are Strong and Steerable Text-Based World Models for Agentic RL

papers.headline: Off-Context GRPO Uses Privileged Guidance to Train LLM Reasoning
papers.why: Incorporating temporary privileged information during rollout generation enables reinforcement learning agents to solve significantly harder reasoning tasks.
papers.title: Off-Context GRPO: Learning to Reason on Hard Problems using Privileged Information

papers.headline: Canary Inputs Catch Malicious Nodes in Decentralized LLM Inference
papers.why: Tracking activation variance in response to secret canary tokens detects malicious participants in peer-to-peer inference networks with high accuracy.
papers.title: Integrity of peer-to-peer distributed LLM inference under malicious nodes
